```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(xml2)


# Load the XML file
xml_file <- read_xml("detail 10.xml")

# Extract precinct-level data
precincts <- xml_file %>%
  xml_find_all("//Precincts/Precinct")

```

```{r}
# Extract precinct-level data
precincts <- xml_file %>%
  xml_find_all("//Precincts/Precinct")

# Create a data frame
precinct_df <- data.frame(
  name = xml_attr(precincts, "name"),
  totalVoters = as.integer(xml_attr(precincts, "totalVoters")),
  ballotsCast = as.integer(xml_attr(precincts, "ballotsCast")),
  voterTurnout = as.numeric(xml_attr(precincts, "voterTurnout")),
  percentReporting = as.numeric(xml_attr(precincts, "percentReporting")),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# View the data frame
print(precinct_df)
```

```{r}

# Extract the Contest node for "For President and Vice President"
contest <- xml_find_first(xml_file, "//Contest[@text='For President and Vice President']")

# Initialize a list to store precinct data
precinct_data <- list()

# Extract VoteType data for the Contest
vote_types <- xml_find_all(contest, "VoteType")

# Create a list for VoteType names
vote_type_names <- sapply(vote_types, function(x) xml_attr(x, "name"))

# Extract Choice nodes for candidates
choices <- xml_find_all(contest, "Choice")

# Loop through each Choice to get votes by precinct
for (choice in choices) {
  choice_name <- xml_attr(choice, "text")  # Candidate name
  precinct_votes <- list()  # Initialize list for precinct votes
  
  # Extract VoteType data for this choice
  choice_vote_types <- xml_find_all(choice, "VoteType")
  choice_vote_type_names <- sapply(choice_vote_types, function(x) xml_attr(x, "name"))

  # Initialize a data frame to hold votes for this candidate
  for (vote_type in choice_vote_types) {
    votes <- xml_attr(vote_type, "votes")  # Get votes for this VoteType
    precinct_votes[[xml_attr(vote_type, "name")]] <- as.numeric(votes)  # Store votes by VoteType
  }

  # Extract precincts associated with this choice
  precincts <- xml_find_all(choice, "Precinct")
  
  # Loop through precincts to get their votes
  for (precinct in precincts) {
    precinct_name <- xml_attr(precinct, "name")
    precinct_votes_df <- data.frame(Precinct = precinct_name)
    
    # Add votes for each VoteType to the precinct
    for (vote_type_name in choice_vote_type_names) {
      precinct_votes_df[[vote_type_name]] <- as.numeric(precinct_votes[[vote_type_name]])
    }
    
    # Add the precinct data for this choice to the main list
    precinct_data[[length(precinct_data) + 1]] <- precinct_votes_df
  }
}

# Combine precinct data into a single data frame
final_df <- do.call(rbind, precinct_data)

# Aggregate votes by precinct if necessary
final_df <- final_df %>%
  group_by(Precinct) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Fill in missing VoteType columns with zeros
final_df[is.na(final_df)] <- 0

# Display the resulting data frame
print(final_df)

)
```
